name: resilient-external-tool-runner
description: Wrap an external tool or flaky network step (such as yt-dlp) in Python with classified failures, bounded exponential-backoff retries, per-item debug logs, a master log, an auto-created config file, an outdated-version warning and a single-file PyInstaller build.

name: flask-socketio-lan-app
description: Build or maintain a Flask + Flask-SocketIO + vanilla-JS real-time app (chat, WebRTC voice, file uploads) that runs on a local network with JSON-file storage and Jinja2 templates.

name: frontend
description: Usa ao alterar a interface em public/ (HTML, CSS, JS do browser). Mantém a UI leve, acessível e sem framework.

name: novo-conversor
description: Usa para acrescentar um formato a um motor existente ou um motor novo (binário externo) ao TugaConverte.

name: sem-limites
description: Usa sempre que estiveres tentado a pôr um limite (tamanho, quantidade, tempo, quota) ou quando o utilizador pedir para limitar. Garante que "sem limites" continua verdade por omissão.

name: agents-md
description: Usa quando for preciso acrescentar, alterar ou revogar uma regra do AGENTS.md, ou atualizar o seu índice.

name: automation-pipeline
description: End-to-end automation recipe for a whole goal with no supervision — prepare, plan, start autopilot, work loop, review, handoff — plus overnight safeguards. ALWAYS use when the user runs /auto or /noite, asks you to "faz tudo sozinho", "automatiza", "trabalha enquanto durmo", "do it end to end", or hands you a large goal and goes away. Complements autonomous-workflow (the loop) with the pipeline around it (setup, budgets, safeguards, closing).

name: autonomous-workflow
description: How to work autonomously during long sessions (~2 hours or more) without interrupting the user. ALWAYS use when the user asks for long/autonomous work, uses /autopilot, says "continue", "work on your own", "do whatever it takes", or when you have a task queue to work through. Covers the work loop, time management, checkpoints, what to do when the queue runs out, how to survive context compression and when (and only when) to stop.

name: decide-without-asking
description: 5-angle decision method for resolving doubts on your own before asking the user. ALWAYS use whenever you feel like asking a question, have two or more options, ambiguous requirements, a design/library/structure choice, or when the user uses /decide. Forces you to analyze precedent, intent, external evidence, risk/reversibility and simplicity, and to record the decision. Only ends in a question to the user if it is a real blocker.

name: ideias
description: Usa para guardar uma ideia ainda sem decisão em ideias.md, ou para promover uma ideia a tarefa.

name: loop-recovery
description: Detect and break out of loops — the agent repeating the same text, tool call, error fix or idea, or producing degenerate/random repeated output — and restart cleanly from the files. ALWAYS use when the user runs /desbloquear-pensamento or says "está preso", "entrou em loop", "repete sempre a mesma coisa", "bugou", "stuck in a loop"; when you notice you produced the same output or the same tool call 3 times; when the same command fails twice with the same error; or when an autopilot iteration makes no measurable progress.

name: planning
description: Break down goals, features or milestones into small, ordered, verifiable tasks, with acceptance criteria, priority and size. ALWAYS use when the user asks to "plan", "/plan", for a new feature, a milestone, a big (L) or vague task, when the TODO.md queue is empty, or before starting any work with more than ~3 steps. Produces entries ready for TODO.md and, if needed, proposals for ROADMAP.md.

name: progress-tracking
description: Mantém o progresso.md atualizado (tarefas das fases F0-F7, estado global, log de decisões, perguntas em aberto). Usa sempre que concluíres uma tarefa, tomares uma decisão de design ou o utilizador responder a uma pergunta em aberto.

name: progresso
description: Como manter o registo docs/progresso.md. Usar no fim de cada bloco de trabalho concluído e no fim de cada sessão, sempre que se corrigir um bug, se descobrir algo sobre o jogo ou a memória, se tomar uma decisão de arquitectura, ou se tentar algo que não funcionou. Diz onde escrever a entrada, o formato, o que incluir, e quando uma descoberta deve passar a Regra do AGENTS.md.

name: project-bootstrap
description: Set up a new project or a template just copied — detect the stack, fill in commands in AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/CONVENTIONS.md, README, ROADMAP and the initial TODO, make sure scripts/check.sh works and get ready for autonomous work. ALWAYS use when the user asks for /bootstrap, when AGENTS.md still has "TODO" commands or {{...}} placeholders, when the repo is empty/new, or when adopting this template in an existing project.

name: project-docs
description: How to read, write and maintain the project's management .md files (README, ROADMAP, TODO, PROGRESS, DECISIONS, QUESTIONS, BUGS, REVIEW, IDEAS, ARCHITECTURE, CHANGELOG, docs/*). ALWAYS use whenever you are about to create, update or consult any of these documents, record a decision, bug, idea, question or progress, or when you don't know where to store information. Also use at the end of every task to know exactly what to update.

name: project-progress-tracker
description: MANDATORY progress tracking for this repository. A cada tarefa que muda o estado do projeto (código, docs, builds, decisões), atualiza PROGRESS.md na raiz: fase atual, o que mudou, o próximo passo. Carrega (lê) PROGRESS.md no início de tarefas grandes para saber onde estamos e consulta PROJECT.md roadmap. Works in PT-PT: the document and updates are written in European Portuguese, identifiers/commits stay in English.

name: sessao-de-trabalho
description: Como trabalhar com eficiência neste repositório, em Windows. Usar no INÍCIO de qualquer sessão ou tarefa e no FIM dela. Diz por onde começar sem ler o AGENTS.md inteiro, como procurar antes de abrir ficheiros grandes, como editar sem estragar codificação nem fins de linha, e a ordem certa do fecho (testes, progresso, commit). Usar também quando se estiver a gastar muito contexto, a reler ficheiros, ou a repetir comandos.

name: session-handoff
description: Session start and end rituals to avoid losing context — startup (read PROGRESS, QUESTIONS, TODO, ROADMAP), checkpoints, pauses, and the final handoff (update docs, verify, commit, summarize). ALWAYS use at the start of any work session, after the context has been compressed, when the user asks for /start, /handoff, or /status, when the time budget is running out, or when you're about to stop for any reason.

name: thinking-levels
description: How deeply to deliberate before and while acting — levels baixo (low), medio (medium) and alto (high), set with /pensamento and stored in .opencode/thinking.level. ALWAYS use at the start of every task, when the user runs /pensamento, says "pensa bem", "pensa a fundo", "faz rápido", "think hard", "quick fix", or when you are unsure how much effort a task deserves. Defines what to read, plan, verify and review at each level, and how level "auto" picks one per task.

name: todo
description: Usa para ler, priorizar, acrescentar ou fechar tarefas em TODO.md.
